//Forge: Temporary prototype balance values for the ordinary forge, not canon.
The blacksmith canon fixes the structure and leaves costs, thresholds and timings as balance data.
Temperature is an abstract 0-100 scale rather than degrees.
StartingMaterials is development bootstrap stock, granted on first use because no economy exists yet.
//Combat: Temporary prototype balance values for the battle prototype, not canon.
The combat canon fixes the structure - one Power stat, the Defense curve's shape, one Energy bar,
a Heavy attack at full Energy, two finite termination guards, 8 active and 16 total - and states
that these numbers are configuration. Unit and weapon combat stats are creator content and live in
TickMilliseconds is a prototype implementation detail: canon requires an authoritative combat clock
on which same-timestamp attacks resolve together, and does not say whether it is stepped.
WeightIntervalSeconds is what each weapon weight is worth in Attack Interval; every equipped weapon
Unarmed is what a Unit holding nothing fights with. Canon does not define it; this is the smallest
answer that keeps a battle legal without inventing an unarmed class ability.
TrainingOpponent is a TEMPORARY BATTLE HARNESS, not game content. There is no recruitment, no PvP
and no authored enemy roster yet. Nothing here is in the Unit registry, nothing is persisted, and
the names are neutral placeholders - no kingdom, no faction, no character, no class. It exists only
so the engine can be watched running, and it is replaced whole when a real opponent exists.
Tuned so a fully deployed three-unit starter army with one forged sword wins with something to
spare, and an under-deployed one loses. Deployment is the decision this harness exists to show.
